claims: The Artemis II mission successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II mission splashed down at 8:07 p.m. EDT on April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission splashed down at 00:07 UTC on April 11, 2026.
The Artemis II mission was a 10-day crewed mission around the Moon.
All four crew members of the Artemis II mission are reported in stable condition.
The crew of the Artemis II mission is safely back on Earth.
The Orion capsule of the Artemis II mission was retrieved by the USS John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission marked the first time humans have traveled around the Moon since 1972.
